vendor_and_service: Public cloud provider (hosts the CCC landing zone; subservice organization)
tier_rationale: All CCC PHI; supports High BIA processes BP-01 and BP-02
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability, Confidentiality) plus bridge letter
subservice_organizations: None carved out for the services used
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: 2 of 60 sampled terminated employees kept badge access for more than 1 day; remediated
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer manages identities, keys, network rules, backups, and restore testing. Mapped to AC-2, SC-12, SC-7, CP-9, CP-4. Company gaps: CP-4 failover (POAM-009); AC-6(5) just-in-time (POAM-003)
availability_vs_bia: Regional services stated at 99.99% for the database; company must design failover to meet its own 2-hour RTO: **met by design, not demonstrated** (P05 finding 1)
incident_notification_terms: Security incident notice per the service terms; subcontractor BAA in place
follow_up: Track CUECs in the SOC 2 control matrix; add failover evidence before 2027-04-01
reviewer_and_date: Security Manager and Compliance and Privacy Officer, 2026-08-28

exceptions_noted: 1 exception: 30-minute escalation missed in 1 of 40 samples

availability_vs_bia: Not a recovery provider; the MSSP's own continuity plan tested annually
incident_notification_terms: Contract: call within 30 minutes on high severity; subcontractor BAA: breach notice within 10 days
follow_up: Extend the contract to OT monitoring; obtain the SIEM platform provider's report
